task.text:
explain : Factors contributing to hyperlipidemia are:
1. Decreased glucose and TG uptake in AT.
2. Overactive of hormone-sensitive lipase
3. Underactive lipoprotein lipase

attempts.high: I'm putting together teaching material on metabolic disorders and I want a fresh way to explain how hyperlipidemia develops. Take these three pieces — reduced glucose/TG uptake in adipose tissue, overactive hormone-sensitive lipase, underactive lipoprotein lipase — and build the explanation however you think works best. Invent an analogy, a framing, a narrative thread, whatever makes the mechanism click. Your call on structure and approach.
attempts.low: Explain each of these three factors contributing to hyperlipidemia, in this exact order, one short paragraph each, under these exact headings: "1. Decreased glucose and TG uptake in AT", "2. Overactive hormone-sensitive lipase", "3. Underactive lipoprotein lipase". Just state the established mechanism for each — no analogies, no added framing, no extra factors beyond the three listed.
